versions.content: On reception of request for DM 0 6 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according Table column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 30 of 97 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager - AUTOSAR confidential - use the common sequence of chapter 7.6.1 ‘ DTC status ’ with the parameters ‘ DTCStatusFilter ’ and ‘DTCKind’ according to Table 2 .
